components.css: .ds-ledger{background:#111c31;color:#f1f5f9;border:1px solid #243350;border-radius:16px;padding:22px 22px 18px;box-shadow:0 28px 48px -28px rgba(0,0,0,.7);max-width:360px}.ds-ledger-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.ds-ledger h2{margin:0;font-size:1.25rem;letter-spacing:-.01em}.ds-badge{padding:4px 10px;border:1px solid #4b5d7c;border-radius:999px;font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:600;color:#b3bfd2}.ds-ledger dl{margin:14px 0 0}.ds-row{padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed #243350}.ds-row dt{font-size:.9375rem;color:#b3bfd2}.ds-row dd{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:1.625rem;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-ledger p{margin:14px 0 0;font-size:.8125rem;color:#b3bfd2}

narrative.overview: A night-time bookkeeping page: deep navy ground, ruled lines instead of boxes, large tabular figures, and one green that means action or confirmed state.
keyCharacteristics: Flat tonal layering with hairline rules
Large tabular figures near the top

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green marks an action or a confirmed state, never decoration.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: line-strong and green-hover are real tokens currently hard-coded; reference them by name.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every money figure and counter uses tabular-nums.

rules.name: The One Raised Surface Rule
rules.body: Only the ledger panel is raised.

dos: Do put figures near the top and set them in tabular numerals.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for any motion added.
donts: Don't put an eyebrow above a heading.
Don't use rows of same-size icon cards.
